card.title: A Turning Point
card.instruction: Treat each emotional shift as proof that this moment will divide everything into before and after.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the first time we've laughed since the inheritance row. Write down today's date.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You tripped over Mum's footstool. I couldn't help it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I didn't mind. That's when we became sisters again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Good. Can we finally sort her furniture?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start a new list. That footstool reunited us; it doesn't go on the inventory from when we hated each other.
